dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Trailing edge exhibits a predominantly linear spline with negligible concavity, transitioning into a broad curvature at the distal extremity.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Broadly rounded apex with an obtuse morphological shape classification.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Steep linear anterior margin measured at approximately 55 degrees relative to the visible dorsal ridge axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Maximum base width to vertical height ratio is approximately 1.45:1.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive punctate depigmentation and small circular white lesions distributed across the dorsal fin and mid-flank; a small irregular indentation is visible on the upper trailing edge near the apex.
other_distinctive_markers: Dense salt-and-pepper pigmentation pattern consisting of high-contrast white speckling against a dark grey epidermal base.
